EventChannel.on(string eventName,function fn)

Continuously listen for an event.

Parameter

string eventName

Event name

function fn

Event listening function

Parameter

any args

Event triggering parameter

Sample Code

ma.navigateTo({ 
    url: '/pages/pageB/index',
    success(res) {
      res.eventChannel.emit('MacleA', {
        data: 'hello World'
      });
    }
});

Page({
    onLoad() {
      const eventChannel = this.getOpenerEventChannel();
      eventChannel.on('MacleA', data => {
        console.log(data); // { "data": "hello World" }
      });
    }
});
